axioms.formula: S(L,U;q) subseteq {L,U}; for interior q the allowed branch set is nonempty.
axioms.name: COMPLETION_NEIGHBOR_LEGALITY

axioms.formula: for a>0, S(aL,aU;aq)=a*S(L,U;q); combined with A1 gives positive affine covariance.
axioms.name: POSITIVE_AFFINE_SCALE_COVARIANCE

axioms.formula: J(q)=L+U-q and J_E(L)=U,J_E(U)=L; S(L,U;J(q))=J_E(S(L,U;q)) as sets.
axioms.name: ENDPOINT_REFLECTION_EQUIVARIANCE

axioms.formula: for q!=(L+U)/2, S(L,U;q) is a singleton; midpoint may remain {L,U}.
axioms.name: DETERMINISTIC_SINGLE_VALUED_AWAY_FROM_EXACT_REFLECTION_FIXED_STATE

axioms.formula: in branch coordinate s(q), increasing q cannot realize a later 1->0 switch; equivalently if q1<q2 and s(q1)=1 then s(q2)=1, and if s(q2)=0 then s(q1)=0.
axioms.name: ORDER_MONOTONICITY

axioms.formula: away from transition points selector is locally constant in order topology and only finitely many transition points occur in each bounded declared gap.
axioms.name: LOCAL_CONSTANCY_FINITE_TRANSITIONS

axioms.formula: for L<M<U: if q in [L,M] and coarse S(L,U;q)={L}, then refined S(L,M;q)={L}; if q in [M,U] and coarse S(L,U;q)={U}, then refined S(M,U;q)={U}. This one-sided exact order compatibility is a control, not used unless explicitly invoked.
axioms.name: ORDERED_REFINEMENT_COMPATIBILITY_CANDIDATE

branch_coordinate: s(L,U;q)=0 means L and 1 means U; set {0,1} means exact unresolved.
registry_lock: Axiom meanings/packages are frozen before selector-family scoring; no post-hoc threshold axiom may be added.
selector_typing: For each ordered completion gap L<U and q in [L,U], S(L,U;q) is set-valued at exact unresolved symmetry and otherwise takes one legal endpoint.
